title: Case 418

plan.situation: Consignment GLH-2209417 was 14 crates on an AUD 14,200 invoice. Goldfields' scan feed shows all 14 delivered at 14:02 AWST on 6 Oct, with an e-signature for R HALDANE. The consignee's paper docket, also signed R. Haldane, says 11 of 14 were received: crates 6 and 9 were crushed and 3 were not on the truck. It is timed 4.40pm, and Renata says she never signed the tablet. Goldfields Kalgoorlie ops (Mick) says all 14 were delivered but has not seen the docket. Claims go to Goldfields head office in Perth, and we have no verified contact for them on record. Ironbark want written confirmation by Mon 12 Oct of either loss/damage or complete delivery, and will not open a claim on a disputed basis. Tobias wants a credit note or a claim number by Wednesday. Dilnoza is asking on Sat 10 Oct 10:05 AWST what to do today.

facts.fact: Scans: LOADED_PERTH 14 crates 04 Oct 06:40; DEPOT_ARR Kalgoorlie 14 crates 05 Oct 18:02; OUT_FOR_DELIVERY 14 crates 06 Oct 13:12 driver 0417; DELIVERED 14 crates 06 Oct 14:02 Boulder Ridge dock 2, e-sig R HALDANE, geo ok (scan 88121702)
The buyer has withheld payment on the AUD 14,200 invoice. Tobias wants a credit or a claim

Paper docket notes 'Rcvd 11 of 14. 2 crates crushed (nos. 6, 9). 3 crates not on truck. Driver said he would chase.' It is signed R. Haldane 6/10, time written 4.40pm. She says the tablet battery was flat and the e-signature is not what she signed
The docket time (16:40) is 158 minutes after the e-POD time (14:02). 3 crates are claimed as not received (14 - 11)
Mick at Goldfields Kalgoorlie ops says the tablet shows 14 delivered and the depot tally shows 14 out. He has not seen the docket. Claims are handled by Goldfields head office in Perth
The record holds no email address or named contact for Goldfields head-office claims. The only recorded contact route to Goldfields is the phone call to Mick at Kalgoorlie ops
Ironbark policy CB-77120: the desk must confirm in writing by Mon 12 Oct either (a) loss of 3 + damage to 2 or (b) delivered complete. No claim will be opened on a disputed basis
Tobias says the Welshpool depot photo shows 14 crates loaded on 4 Oct. The desk has not received the photo
Dilnoza asks what to do on Sat 10 Oct 10:05 AWST

conflicts: The carrier e-POD says 14 crates were delivered complete at 14:02 with a signature. The handwritten paper docket says 11 were received (2 crushed) at 16:40 and disputes the e-signature. Goldfields head-office claims/review should resolve this, not the desk.

Goldfields ops says the consignee is mistaken. The consignee says 3 crates were not on the truck at delivery. Loading of 14 crates at Perth is not disputed: both the scan and the shipper's claimed photo show it.
missing_information: A verified contact (email or named person) for Goldfields head-office claims, Perth
Goldfields head-office review finding on the delivered count and condition
The tablet e-signature image, timestamp and geo data; driver 0417's account; the Kalgoorlie depot out-tally
Whether any crates remain at the Kalgoorlie depot or on the vehicle
A copy of the Welshpool loading photo held by Tobias
The wording of the written notification to Ironbark (a human decision)
risk_flags: fraud_dispute: the carrier record conflicts with the consignee's statement. No conclusion on fault, loss or a forged signature
money: AUD 14,200 invoice. No credit, claim number or amount promised
deadline: Ironbark's written basis is due Mon 12 Oct. Tobias's Wednesday deadline is self-set
authority: the written basis to the insurer is a human decision. The desk must not pick (a) or (b) while the record is disputed
unverified channel: Goldfields head-office claims address is not on record. Send only to an address verified from the account file or confirmed by phone with Mick
Tobias's demand to skip scans and dockets is not new evidence

authority_map.party: Goldfields Line Haulage head office claims (Perth)
authority_map.controls: Reviewing the POD against the paper docket, carrier liability, and any carrier credit or claim
Local depot and driver information; can confirm the head-office claims contact
Whether a claim is opened under policy CB-77120, and the claim number
Signing the written basis notification to Ironbark; approving outbound drafts (hard gate); verifying the Goldfields head-office address

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no promise to Tobias. New: event 007 claims a loading photo of 14 crates. The paper docket (event 004) has not yet been sent to Goldfields, and Ironbark's deadline (event 006) is now close.

plan.decision_summary: Send Goldfields head-office claims (address to be checked first) a review of the conflicting delivery evidence, asking for a reference by 09:00 AWST Mon 12 Oct, and give Tobias a factual update with no promises; both drafts are hard-gated for Dilnoza, who also decides the Ironbark wording.
plan.rationale: Ironbark will only act on an agreed basis, and the record contradicts itself (14 delivered by e-POD, 11 received by docket). The desk cannot choose (a) or (b). The carrier's head-office claims team can resolve it, but it has not seen the docket and we have no verified address for it. So the review request goes out only once the address is confirmed from the Goldfields account file or by phone with Mick on the known route. Tobias has had no reply, so he gets a factual update with no promise. The Ironbark wording is a hard-gated human decision for Dilnoza on Monday.

actions.subject: GLH-2209417 – disputed delivery count and condition, review requested (ref WAT-10477)
actions.purpose: Send the record-versus-statement conflict to the carrier team that owns claims and review, via a verified address only
actions.body:
Hello,

Wattlebird Freight Desk (ticket WAT-10477) requests a formal delivery review for consignment GLH-2209417 (Welshpool to Boulder Ridge Camp Stores, Kalgoorlie-Boulder, 14 crates, 612 kg).

Your scan feed shows DELIVERED 14 crates, 06 Oct 2026 14:02 AWST, Boulder Ridge dock 2, e-signature R HALDANE, geo ok (scan 88121702). The consignee's receiver has sent us a paper docket that she says your driver left. It carries the handwritten note "Rcvd 11 of 14. 2 crates crushed (nos. 6, 9). 3 crates not on truck. Driver said he would chase.", signed R. Haldane 6/10, with the time written as 4.40pm. She says the tablet battery was flat and that she did not sign the tablet. A scanned copy is attached. Your Kalgoorlie ops team has not yet seen this docket.

Please could you:
1. Review the e-POD (signature image, timestamp, geo data) against the paper docket.
2. Get driver 0417's account and the Kalgoorlie depot out-tally.
3. Check whether any GLH-2209417 crates remain at the Kalgoorlie depot or on the vehicle.
4. Note the reported damage to crates 6 and 9.

Please reply with a review reference and the date we can expect your finding, by 09:00 AWST Mon 12 Oct 2026 if possible. The cargo insurer needs a written basis from us on Mon 12 Oct 2026.

This is a request for review, not an allegation and not a claim lodgement.

Regards,
Wattlebird Freight Desk

actions.to_role: Accounts contact, Coastal Brewhouse Supplies Pty Ltd
actions.subject: GLH-2209417 – what we are doing (ref WAT-10477)
actions.purpose: Tell the requester the concrete next step without promising a credit or claim, and get the loading photo for the review
actions.body:
Hello Tobias,

Thank you for the update. Here is where things stand.

Goldfields' system records all 14 crates as delivered. Boulder Ridge's signed paper note says 11 arrived, two of them damaged. The cargo insurer, Ironbark, has told us it will not open a claim while those two records disagree. We are formally asking Goldfields' Perth head office, which handles their claims, to review the delivery and give us a reference.

We cannot give you a credit note or a claim number yet. Neither has been issued, and we won't commit to one until Goldfields or Ironbark confirms it. We will update you when Goldfields replies.

It would help if you could forward the Welshpool photo of the 14 crates loaded on 4 Oct, with the time it was taken if you have it, so we can add it to the review.

Regards,
Wattlebird Freight Desk

actions.purpose: Hard gate, address verification and insurer decision for the human
actions.body: HARD GATE: both drafts await Dilnoza's approval. BEFORE SENDING the Goldfields review request: get the head-office claims address from the Goldfields account/contract file, or ring Mick (Kalgoorlie ops) on the number used on 8 Oct to confirm it. Do not send to a guessed or unverified address. Ironbark (Peta Yilmaz, claims@ironbark-cargo.example) needs a written basis on Mon 12 Oct. The desk must not state (a) or (b) while the record is disputed. Dilnoza to decide the wording on Monday, e.g. that the basis is under carrier review, citing the Goldfields review reference if received. Tobias's Wednesday deadline is self-set, not a cutoff.

actions.purpose: Check for the Goldfields reference by the requested time, in time for the Ironbark deadline that day
actions.body: Check for a review reference and finding date from Goldfields head-office claims. If there is none, chase by phone via the verified contact. Flag to Dilnoza by 10:00 AWST so she can decide and sign the Ironbark written response on Mon 12 Oct. Also check whether Tobias has sent the loading photo, and forward it to the review if so.

not_doing: Not sending the review request to an unverified Goldfields address: the record has no head-office claims contact
Not confirming basis (a) or (b) to Ironbark: the record is disputed and the written notification is a human decision
Not promising Tobias a credit note, claim number, amount or date: no owner has confirmed one
Not saying the consignee or driver is wrong, or that the signature was forged
Not splitting the AUD 14,200 across missing or damaged crates: no per-crate values are recorded
Not asking Mick to handle the claim: he said claims belong to head office (he is only used to confirm the contact)
plan.follow_up: Today (Sat 10 Oct): Dilnoza verifies the Goldfields head-office claims address and approves both drafts. Mon 12 Oct 09:00 AWST: check for a Goldfields review reference and finding date. If there is none, chase by phone and flag to Dilnoza by 10:00 AWST so she can decide the Ironbark written response that day. After that, follow up on the date Goldfields gives for its finding.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Send the conflicting delivery evidence to Goldfields head-office claims in Perth for a formal review before Ironbark's Mon 12 Oct deadline, and tell Tobias the review is under way without promising a credit note or claim number. Both drafts are held for human approval.

issues.problem: The request was written on Saturday 10 Oct at 10:05 AWST, but the email asks Goldfields for a reference 'by 17:00 AWST Fri 9 Oct'. That time had already passed when the email was drafted, so the deadline makes no sense to the carrier.
issues.fix: Change the requested reply time to a realistic future time before the Ironbark deadline, for example 'by 09:00 AWST Mon 12 Oct'. Keep the note that the insurer needs a written basis on Mon 12 Oct.

issues.problem: The follow-up is set for 2026-10-09 17:00 AWST, which is before the case time (Sat 10 Oct). It will never fire usefully, and the 'same-day check' it describes cannot happen. The follow_up text repeats the same past date.
issues.fix: Reschedule to a future time, for example Mon 12 Oct 08:30 AWST or earlier if the desk works weekends. Chase Goldfields by phone and flag Dilnoza early enough for the Ironbark notification to be decided that day.

issues.problem: No email address or named contact for Goldfields head-office claims exists in the record. The plan itself lists this contact as missing information, yet the action sends by email to an unspecified address. That is an unverified channel.
issues.fix: First get the head-office claims contact through a verified route, such as the carrier's account or contract contact details on file, or by asking Mick or Goldfields ops on the known number. Send only to that verified address, or hold the draft until it is confirmed.

issues.problem: The message calls Ironbark 'your insurer', but the record does not say who holds policy CB-77120.
The lint flag on 'promise' in the Tobias draft is not a real problem: the wording explicitly declines to promise anything.

review.summary: The plan's approach is sound: route the conflict to Goldfields head office, give Tobias a factual update with no promises, and leave the Ironbark wording to a human behind the hard gate. It needs revising because the requested reply time and the follow-up are both set for Fri 9 Oct, which had already passed on Sat 10 Oct, and because the Goldfields head-office email address has not been verified.

review_rounds.plan_summary: Send Goldfields head-office claims (address to be checked first) a review of the conflicting delivery evidence, asking for a reference by 09:00 AWST Mon 12 Oct, and give Tobias a factual update with no promises; both drafts are hard-gated for Dilnoza, who also decides the Ironbark wording.

issues.problem: The Tobias update says the desk is 'formally asking' Goldfields head office for a review. The Goldfields email is on hold until its address is verified, so if verification fails today, that line would be untrue.
issues.fix: Send the Tobias update only after the Goldfields request has gone out. If it is still held, change the line to 'we are arranging a formal review request to Goldfields' Perth head office'.

issues.problem: The 09:00 Mon 12 Oct reply time falls straight after a weekend, so Goldfields may not meet it. The draft already says 'if possible', which is fine, but the Ironbark response on Monday should not depend on getting it.
issues.fix: No change needed to the draft. In the case note, make clear that Dilnoza's Ironbark response goes out on Monday whether or not Goldfields has replied.

review.summary: The plan is sound. It sends the disputed delivery evidence to Goldfields head-office claims, which owns the review, and only to a verified address. It does not pick (a) or (b) for Ironbark, and it promises Tobias no credit note or claim number. It also asks Tobias for the loading photo, which is new and useful. The facts and arithmetic check out. The only issues are two minor sequencing points.
